summary: BBB Foods Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a mixed primary/secondary offering of 13,304,174 Class A common shares at US$32.50 per share, with 700,000 from the issuer and 12,604,174 from selling shareholders (issuable upon conversion of Class C shares). Bolton Partners Ltd., an insider, sells 150,000 shares and exercises preemptive rights to buy 10,000 Class B shares. The company retains multi-class voting structure; proceeds to issuer are ~US$22M. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation, as it involves no control change, tender, or restructuring.
